body: Looks like `command_line_enter` is re-entered during another `command_line_enter` call, leaving `ccline` in an inconsistent state

Call stack looks like this: `command_line_enter` -> ... -> `command_line_execute` -> `multiqueue_process_events` -> `on_channel_event` ->  ... -> `call_func` -> ... -> `exec_normal_cmd` (command is `:echomsg ...`) -> ... -> `nv_colon` -> ... -> `command_line_enter`

And at the end of that `command_line_enter`, `ccline.cmdbuff` is set to NULL, but `ccline.cmdbufflen` is unchanged, so next `realloc_cmdbuff` will leave `ccline.cmdbuff` NULL. Causing neovim to crash when try to write to ccline.cmdbuff.

Simply set `ccline.cmdbufflen` to 0 doesn't solve this problem. The crash when instead happen in `realloc_cmdbuff`, since it assumes `ccline.cmdbuff` to not be NULL.

BTW, the stack trace in top post actually corresponds to when you unfocus then refocus the neovim window.
